description_en: Sets live stream prefetch tasks. You can prefetch up to 100 live streams in a batch
description_zh: 设置直播预热任务，支持批量设置直播流预热
kebab_example: aliyun live set-live-stream-preload-tasks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --play-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000 --area domestic --preloaded-start-time 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z --preloaded-end-time 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetLiveStreamPreloadTasks

parameters.help_en: The live stream URLs. You can specify multiple URLs separated by commas (,). A maximum of 100 URLs can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 直播URL，支持批量设置多个直播URL，多个URL之间用逗号（,）分隔，不超过100个
parameters.name: play_url

parameters.help_en:
The prefetch area. Valid values:
domestic: the Chinese mainland.
overseas: outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China).
global: global acceleration.
 
If you do not specify this parameter, the default prefetch area is the acceleration region configured for your domain name
parameters.help_zh:
预热区域。取值：
domestic：中国内地。
overseas：海外及港澳台加速。
global：全球加速。
 
如果不传该参数，默认的预热区域为您的域名所配置的加速区域
parameters.name: area

parameters.help_en: The start time of the prefetch task in UTC. Example: 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z. If you do not specify this parameter, the default prefetch duration is 1 hour
parameters.help_zh: 预热开始时间，UTC格式，例如：2016-06-29T19:00:00Z，不填默认预热1小时
parameters.name: preloaded_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the prefetch task in UTC. Example: 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 6 hours
parameters.help_zh: 预热结束时间，UTC格式，例如：2016-06-30T19:00:00Z，EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过6小时
parameters.name: preloaded_end_time

FailedURL.description_en: The number of URLs for which the prefetch task failed
FailedURL.description_zh: 预热任务设置失败的URL条数

PreloadTasksMessage.description_en: The details of the live stream prefetch task

items.description_en: The details of the live stream prefetch task

Description.description_en:
Indicates whether the prefetch task is successful. Valid values:
Successfully: successful.
InternalError: failed
Description.description_zh:
预热任务是否成功。取值：
Successfully：成功。
InternalError：失败

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Success: successful.
Failed: failed.

The status is Failed if any task fails to be created
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
Success：成功。
Failed：失败。

只要有一条任务创建失败即为失败

SuccessURL.description_en: The number of URLs for which the prefetch task succeeded
SuccessURL.description_zh: 预热任务设置成功的URL条数

TotalURL.description_en: The total number of URLs in the prefetch task
